notes.title: Language Update 1: Chinese and Italian
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Night Reverie: Prologue is now available in the following languages:

[list]
[*] English
[*] Spanish
[*] Italian (new)
[*] Simplified Chinese (new)
[*] Traditional Chinese (new)
[/list]
We are also thrilled to announce that we are now working with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indienova]Indienova [/url]as a publisher to bring Night Reverie to more players in China.

We are really thankful to all players who have downloaded and played Night Reverie: Prologue. It’s really heartwarming reading your feedback on the game. We guarantee we are putting 100% effort to bring you the best possible experience in the complete game: Night Reverie.

Of course, we will progressively translate the game to many other languages. We want Night Reverie to be enjoyed by everyone.

You can support us immensely by adding Night Reverie to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1254670

Feel free to join us on this beautiful game development adventure:

[url=https://discord.gg/2DPmTeP][img]https://i.imgur.com/oA6eEIa.png[/img][/url]
